import os
import warnings
import logging

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
logging.getLogger().setLevel(logging.WARNING)
logging.getLogger("lightgbm").setLevel(logging.ERROR)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from scipy.sparse import hstack

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("=" * 60)
print("Loading Data...")
print("=" * 60)

train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")


# Preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip()
    text = text.strip('"')
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\r", "\r").replace("\\t", "\t")
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


print("\nCleaning text...")
train["clean_comment"] = train["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test["clean_comment"] = test["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Date Feature Engineering
print("\nProcessing date features...")

date_features_train = []
for val in train["Date"]:
    try:
        date_str = str(val).replace("Z", "")
        year = int(date_str[:4])
        month = int(date_str[4:6])
        day = int(date_str[6:8])
        hour = int(date_str[8:10])
        minute = int(date_str[10:12])
        second = int(date_str[12:14])
        days_in_month = [0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334]
        day_of_year = days_in_month[month - 1] + day
        date_features_train.append([year, month, day_of_year, hour, minute, second])
    except:
        date_features_train.append([-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1])

date_features_test = []
for val in test["Date"]:
    try:
        date_str = str(val).replace("Z", "")
        year = int(date_str[:4])
        month = int(date_str[4:6])
        day = int(date_str[6:8])
        hour = int(date_str[8:10])
        minute = int(date_str[10:12])
        second = int(date_str[12:14])
        days_in_month = [0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334]
        day_of_year = days_in_month[month - 1] + day
        date_features_test.append([year, month, day_of_year, hour, minute, second])
    except:
        date_features_test.append([-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1])

date_features_train = pd.DataFrame(
    date_features_train,
    columns=["year", "month", "day_of_year", "hour", "minute", "second"],
)
date_features_test = pd.DataFrame(
    date_features_test,
    columns=["year", "month", "day_of_year", "hour", "minute", "second"],
)

print(
    f"Date features extracted: Train {date_features_train.shape}, Test {date_features_test.shape}"
)

# Additional feature: keyword counts
print("\nCreating additional features...")
insult_keywords = ["idiot", "asshole", "stupid", "troll", "ignorant"]
profanity_words = ["fuck", "shit", "damn", "hell", "bitch", "bastard"]

train_keyword_count = (
    train["clean_comment"]
    .str.lower()
    .apply(lambda x: sum(x.count(kw) for kw in insult_keywords))
)
test_keyword_count = (
    test["clean_comment"]
    .str.lower()
    .apply(lambda x: sum(x.count(kw) for kw in insult_keywords))
)

# Build TF-IDF features
print("\nBuilding TF-IDF features...")
X_train_full = train[["clean_comment"]]
X_test = test[["clean_comment"]]

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000,
    stop_words="english",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_full["clean_comment"])
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test["clean_comment"])

# Convert to dense arrays for LightGBM
X_train_vec_dense = X_train_vec.toarray()
X_test_vec_dense = X_test_vec.toarray()

print(f"TF-IDF matrix shape: {X_train_vec_dense.shape}")

# Combine features
X_train_combined = np.hstack(
    [
        X_train_vec_dense,
        train_keyword_count.values.reshape(-1, 1),
        date_features_train.values,
    ]
)
X_test_combined = np.hstack(
    [
        X_test_vec_dense,
        test_keyword_count.values.reshape(-1, 1),
        date_features_test.values,
    ]
)

print(
    f"Combined features shape: Train {X_train_combined.shape}, Test {X_test_combined.shape}"
)

# Target variable
y_train = train["Insult"]

print(f"\nTarget distribution: 0={(y_train==0).sum()}, 1={(y_train==1).sum()}")

# Create validation split BEFORE training
print("\nCreating validation split...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train,
    shuffle=True,
)

print(f"Training set size: {X_tr.shape[0]}, Validation set size: {X_val.shape[0]}")

# Train Model on training data ONLY (never see validation during training)
print("\nTraining LightGBM Classifier...")
clf = LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=None,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
)

clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
print("Model training complete.")

# Evaluate on genuine hold-out validation set
print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_probs = np.clip(val_probs, 0, 1)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)

print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (genuine hold-out): {val_auc:.6f}")
print(f"  Positive class examples in val: {(y_val == 1).sum()} / {len(y_val)}")
print(f"  Negative class examples in val: {(y_val == 0).sum()} / {len(y_val)}")

# Generate predictions on TEST set
print("\nGenerating predictions on TEST set...")
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 0, 1)

assert len(test_probs) == len(
    test
), f"Mismatch: {len(test_probs)} predictions vs {len(test)} test samples"

# Load sample submission to verify format
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")
sub_template = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Create submission dataframe matching sample format exactly
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Insult": test_probs,
        "Comment": test["Comment"].values,
        "Date": test["Date"].values,
    }
)

# Reorder columns to match template
cols_order = list(sub_template.columns)
sub_df = sub_df[cols_order]

# Save to correct location
final_submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(final_submission_path), exist_ok=True)
sub_df.to_csv(final_submission_path, index=False)

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("SUMMARY")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Submission saved to: {final_submission_path}")
print(f"Submission shape: {sub_df.shape}")
print(f"Rows match test data: {sub_df.shape[0] == len(test)}")
print(f"First column name: {sub_df.columns[0]}")
print(f"Predictions range: [{test_probs.min():.4f}, {test_probs.max():.4f}]")
print(f"AUC-ROC (validation hold-out): {val_auc:.6f}")
print(f"Positive predictions (>50%): {(test_probs > 0.5).sum()}")
print(f"High confidence (>0.8): {(test_probs > 0.8).sum()}")
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("READY FOR EVALUATION!")
print("=" * 60)
